name: Meet MILF: Valeria
source:
Five years ago, you started working in a “construction agency” for your uncle. During this time, you became a pretty good architect and gained design skills. Having saved up some money, you have decided to move to another country where you began to improve your life. And at one fine moment, you realized that it was time to end the bachelor period of your life. That’s how you met Valeria, a woman who would change your life. Although it wouldn’t change only because of her…

[From [url=https://mavpabuf.itch.io/meet-milf-valeria]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
五年前，你进入舅舅名下的一家“建筑事务所”工作。在此期间，你成长为一名相当出色的建筑师，练就了扎实的设计功底。攒下一笔积蓄后，你决定移居异国他乡改善生活。而在某个美好的时刻，你意识到是时候结束自己的单身汉生涯了——就在这时，你邂逅了瓦莱里娅，一位即将改变你一生的成熟女性。尽管令你生活天翻地覆的，还不止她一人……
